transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, we've got 1,200 cast aluminum housings on hold due to cosmetic residue from the forming operation. I need to make a decision on whether to authorize rework and release the campaign plan, but before I do that, I want to make sure we go through our standard pre-authorization process. That means we need process engineering, maintenance, quality, and environmental health and safety all present and signed off. I'd like to hear from each of you on the current situation and whether we're ready to proceed with an ultrasonic cleaning rework. Let's start with where things stand.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share the results of my process trial. I completed the trial yesterday and found that the residue can be successfully removed from only 900 of the 1,200 housings using ultrasonic cleaning. The remaining 300 housings have embedded residue that cannot be removed with this method and must remain on hold. I have not yet entered this result into the production release system.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something on the maintenance side. During my weekly walkdown of the ultrasonic cleaning cell, I found that the circulation-pump seal needs to be replaced before we can use the cell. It's a planned 4-hour downtime. I identified the issue but haven't opened the maintenance work order yet, so we need to account for that time in the campaign schedule.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share something on the quality side. I confirmed in the customer control plan this morning that every reworked housing must receive dimensional scanning, and the plan requires exactly 30 reworked housings to be retained for customer review. I received the revised plan from the customer portal this morning, but I have not yet updated our local inspection instruction to reflect these requirements.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: On the environmental health and safety side, I need to share the results of my waste review. I determined that the spent cleaning solution from this campaign must be collected in exactly 2 sealed waste totes and shipped under a waste manifest. I confirmed the classification with our site's waste contractor this week, but I have not yet updated the area waste-board notice to reflect this requirement.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Enter the trial results into the production release system reflecting 900 reworkable housings and 300 remaining on hold.
Open the maintenance work order for the circulation-pump seal replacement and schedule the 4-hour downtime before the rework campaign begins.
Update the local inspection instruction to reflect dimensional scanning of all 900 reworked housings and retention of 30 housings for customer review per the revised customer control plan.
Update the area waste-board notice to reflect the requirement for exactly 2 sealed waste totes shipped under a waste manifest for spent cleaning solution.
Complete the standard pre-authorization sign-off from process engineering, maintenance, quality, and EHS before the rework campaign begins.
